chunks: From him, from Al-Jamourani, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Sandal, from Abu Al-Sabbah Al-Kinani, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, loves from among His believing servants every servant who supplicates. Therefore, it is upon you to supplicate during the pre-dawn period until the emergence of the sun, for it is a time in which the doors of the sky are opened, sustenance is distributed, and great needs are fulfilled.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of supplicating during the pre-dawn hours in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking the spiritual act of dua to the cosmic mechanics of rizq (sustenance) and divine favor. This period, known as the 'time of acceptance,' is historically emphasized in Shia jurisprudence as a critical window for istighathah (seeking help), reflecting the belief that divine decree is actively distributed during these hours.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Al Jamourany, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Sandal, from Abu Al Sabbah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Loves from the Momineen of Hisazwj servant, every servant who supplicates. Therefore, it is upon you with the supplication during the pre-dawn up to the emergence of the sun, for it is a time in which the doors of the skies are Opened up and the sustenance are distributed, and in which the great needs are Fulfilled’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from al-Jamurani from al- Hassan ibn Ali ibn abu Hamza from Sandal from abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, from among His believing people loves every prayerful one. You should pray during the last part of the night until sunrise; it is the hour in which the doors of heaven open up, sustenance is distributed and people in need are granted great help.”
